reviews.title: SO GLITCHY.
reviews.text: Just bought this to help promote my business through reels. It is SO glitchy. Pictures not appearing when they should, previews not playing properly, reel length refusing to shorten even though the last 20 seconds is completely empty. I have spent a long time trying to do one reel, and the options are basic, picture editing tools are basic. From what I can see on the premium version it's not great, and considering the app doesn't even work as it should I'm not going to risk wasting my money. Will use another app.

reviews.title: Good luck editing anything!
reviews.text: Ugh!  I hate this app.  If you use the templates exactly as they are, you’re fine.  But if you want to edit anything, you’re screwed.  It’s clunky, doesn’t follow your fingers, moves things to weird places for no reason, doesn’t let you make even small adjustments, the timeline is so tiny unless you have the fingers of a 5-year-old, good luck selecting any one element on the timeline.  I wish they would make a desktop version that would be easier to edit.

reviews.title: They scam you into the app
reviews.text: They will obligate you to subscribe to a $90 subscription to try an app that basically offers nothing and then won’t refund you the amount. Even when cancelling the “free 3 days” you get charged. Contacted Apple and they told me it was the devs decision to not refund me, what a money grab. Will place a claim with the bank and the appropriate consumer protection departments as it seems I’m not the only one affected by these fraudsters.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time

reviews.title: Deceitful
reviews.text: I signed up for a free trial. This app charged me for a whole year a day before the trial was supposed to end. I caught it the same day they charged me, cancelled the free trial, and my refund request in the App Store was denied. I can’t stand these slimy practices that try to squeeze money out of users by counting on their forgetfulness, and I didn’t even forget this time.
